question: Which of the following is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unisexual flower - Watermelon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Watermelon** (Citrullus lanatus) is known for producing **unisexual flowers**, meaning that each flower is either male or female.
 
• In watermelon plants, male flowers produce pollen, while female flowers develop into the fruit after pollination.
 
• Unisexual flowers in watermelons help in ensuring cross-pollination, which can lead to better genetic diversity and fruit production.
 
• Pollination in watermelons is typically carried out by bees, which transfer pollen from male to female flowers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unisexual Flowers:**

 
 
• Unisexual flowers contain either male (staminate) or female (pistillate) reproductive organs, but not both.
 
• Examples of plants with unisexual flowers include cucumbers, pumpkins, and corn.
 
 
 
• **Bisexual Flowers:**
 
 
• Bisexual flowers contain both male and female reproductive organs within the same flower.
 
• Examples include roses, lilies, and tomatoes.
 
 
 
• **Pollination:**
 
 
• Pollination is the process of transferring pollen from the male part of the flower (anther) to the female part (stigma).
 
• It can occur via wind, water, or animals (particularly insects like bees).
 
 
 
• **Cross-Pollination:**
 
 
• Cross-pollination involves the transfer of pollen from the flower of one plant to the flower of another plant of the same species.
 
• This process enhances genetic diversity within a plant species.
